svg.title: What happens to a keystroke
svg.desc: Connecting: HostConnection resolves credentials, SSHEngine connects through Citadel, the host key is checked, and a PTY shell opens at the terminal's real size. After that, keystrokes go from SwiftTerm's TerminalView through TerminalSession and SSHEngine to the server, and output comes back through SSHEngine and MarginModeFilter into TerminalView, which draws the screen.

svg.text: Resize: SwiftTerm reports the new columns and rows, and SSHEngine.resize sends a window-change. The keep-alive timer re-sends that

svg.text: same window-change so an idle session isn't dropped. MarginModeFilter is a stopgap until SwiftTerm #707 ships — see docs/backlog.md.
